name: Illawarra Credit Union
legalName: Brand of Community First Credit Union Limited (ABN 80 087 649 938, AFSL/ACL 231204); brand retired 1 April 2026
funder: Community First Credit Union Limited, operating as Community First Bank

notes.value: Illawarra Credit Union no longer exists as a separate lender. Community First Bank states: "From 1 April 2026, the Illawarra Credit Union brand will transition to Community First Bank - this is final step in our member-approved merger" and "From 1 April 2026, the Illawarra Credit Union brand will be formally retired and we will operate under one unified brand - Community First Bank." The merger itself was approved at special general meetings in late 2024 and the entities were combined during 2025. From 1 April 2026 illawarracu.com.au redirects to communityfirst.com.au (confirmed live). Assess any new lending against the 'community-first-bank' record.
notes.sourceTitle: Community First Bank — Illawarra Credit Union is becoming Community First Bank
notes.note: The same page notes that Community First Credit Union Limited operates the brands Illawarra Credit Union, Community First Bank and Easy Street Financial Services under one banking licence.

gaps: This lender no longer exists as a distinct brand — status is 'withdrawn'. The record exists only so the id resolves and nothing is matched to it.
